answer: Zero-knowledge passport-bound personhood: each agent binds its key to one passport via a proof revealing only a nullifier, never the document. Three peers verify the proof and check the nullifier is fresh, a willow bending to privacy. Reusing one passport exposes the duplicate nullifier and freezes both identities with rewards burned, so the ridge of one person, one identity cannot be crossed twice. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 real passports, about $50,000 plus criminal exposure, while one honest agent proves once and pays nothing against the gale of fakes.
